title.description: Teable Apps can act on their own behalf, directly performing operations through the API, without impersonating a user. See our Help documentation for more information.

name.label: OAuth App name
name.description: The name of your OAuth App.

homePageUrl.label: Homepage URL
homePageUrl.description: The full URL to your OAuth App’s website.

logo.label: Logo
logo.placeholder: Drag and drop your logo here or click to upload

callbackUrl.label: Callback URL
callbackUrl.description: The full URL to redirect to after a user authorizing your integration.

deviceFlow.label: Enable device flow
deviceFlow.description: Allow this app to sign users in with a one-time code typed in a browser (for CLIs and devices without one). Anyone who knows the client ID can start this flow in your app's name, so enable it only if your app needs it.

secret.label: Client secrets
secret.newDescription: Make sure to copy your new client secret now. You won’t be able to see it again.
secret.empty: You need a client secret to authenticate as the application to the API.

decision.title: {{name}} is requesting access to your account
decision.scopes: This application will be able to get the following scopes:

device.title: Connect a device
device.description: Enter the 8-character code shown in your terminal to sign that device in to your account.
device.invalidCode: That code is invalid or has expired. Check your terminal and try again.
device.codeUsed: That code has already been used. Run the login command again to get a new code.
device.deviceFlowDisabled: This app does not allow signing in with a device code.
device.confirmCode: Make sure it matches the code shown in your terminal.
device.phishingHint: Device codes are a common phishing target and can be used to sign in to your account. Never share yours, and only continue if you started this sign-in yourself.
device.phishingHintStrong: If you did not mean to open this page, or the link came from someone else, close this tab.
device.approvedDescription: You can close this page and go back to your terminal.
device.deniedDescription: That device was not granted access. You can close this page.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete OAuth App
deleteConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to delete the {{name}} OAuth App? This action cannot be undone.
